Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misidentified the director as Edward Dmytryk by conflating the 1965 film “Mirage” (directed by Dmytryk) with the 1972 Peruvian film “Mirage” (directed by Armando Robles Godoy). This reflects a failure to properly disambiguate by year/title and a misreading of the search results, which clearly indicated Armando Robles Godoy for the 1972 film.
